```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(Tmisc)
```

## Starwars EDA

```{r}
#| label: glimpse

glimpse(starwars)
nrow(starwars)
ncol(starwars)
dim(starwars)
```

```{r}
#| label: data-visualization
#| warning: FALSE

ggplot(starwars, aes(x = height, y = mass)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Mass vs. height of Starwars characters", x = "Height (cm)", y = "Weight (kg)")
```

## Anscombe's quartet EDA

```{r}
quartet

quartet %>%
  group_by(set) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_x = mean(x),
    mean_y = mean(y),
    sd_x = sd(x),
    sd_y = sd(y),
    r = cor(x, y)
  )

ggplot(quartet, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(. ~set) +
  labs(title = "Anscombe's quartet")
```
